Full npm validation cannot run in connected GitHub repository from this session; publisher must validate before public materialization.

contrary_evidence: CEBC Chinese investment totals fluctuate strongly across years and cannot be extrapolated into a smooth acceleration; the 2025 value is not an annual Banco Central FDI inflow.
Brazil's bilateral merchandise surplus coexists with concentration of around 74% of China-bound exports in three raw commodities, so surplus does not prove industrial upgrading.
Corporate acquisitions alter ownership without automatically adding new physical production; even greenfield manufacturing can have highly imported intermediate content.
Rail projects presented to investors in June 2026 are a potential Brazilian multi-source portfolio, not committed Chinese financing.
Evidence of labor violations in Camaçari comes from Ministry of Labor administrative inspection and is not a final criminal judgment.
limitations: Assistant-led independent editorial stage rather than external human peer review; selected key primary sources were independently verified, not each historical/institutional claim exhaustively audited.
CEBC methodology counts implemented/started project capital under classifications that differ from the Central Bank's balance-of-payments direct-investment accounting.
Historical CEBC cumulative stock is a sum of catalogued project investment, not market valuation of current claims and shares.
Trade records are nominal FOB goods only; value added, services and income transfers require separate measures.
2026 bilateral trade figures cover January to October, not the closed year.
Brazil and China corporate projects require case-level proof of technology transfer, labor conditions and environmental effects; aggregate estimates are insufficient.
Actual public publishing is conditioned on SHA-bound promotion, index update, reconciliation, site validation and successful deployment.
notes: Independent editorial pass executed under on-demand MT 4/5 QA procedure after user-requested publication. Key primary figures, chart years and methodological distinctions directly cross-checked against dated institutional sources, manuscript integrity and bilingual parity; source sampling and deployment conditions explicitly disclosed.

contrary_evidence: Chinese project investment is not a monotonic series: annual CEBC values vary markedly, including much lower years in 2020 and 2022.
2025 trade with China was strongly surplus-positive in nominal goods while approximately 74% of export value was concentrated in three commodities.
Acquisitions can change ownership and dividend distribution without new productive capacity; greenfield projects may rely on imported equipment and inputs.
Chinese financing or ownership of regulated assets does not automatically override Brazilian legal and regulatory authority.
Local automotive assembly does not by itself establish local cell, chip, software or component production.
Some large infrastructure proposals are feasibility studies or prospective portfolios, not executed investment.
limitations: CEBC 2007–2025 cumulative US$85.5bn/355-project estimate is a catalogued historical investment total, not a marked-to-market inward FDI position; its component percentages/values contain rounding or classification discrepancies.
CEBC confirmed/started projects are not a complete cash-disbursement ledger, and some projects span multiple years.
Official trade totals are nominal merchandise FOB statistics, without full trade-in-services, profit-remittance or value-added accounts.
The most recent available 2026 China trade comparison is January–October only, not final calendar-year 2026.
Future 2027–2035 paths are conditional qualitative scenarios without invented numerical probabilities.

Project-specific environmental, labor and technology-transfer outcomes require additional audited local evidence; labor inspection findings are attributed to the competent authority and not described as a final criminal conviction.
Independent editorial QA, cryptographic approval, transfer to public reports, build and deployment have not yet occurred.
